title: The UK Job Market Is Broken | 3 Things You MUST Do in 2026
description:
The UK Job Market Is Broken | 3 Things You MUST Do in 2026


The UK job market in 2026 is fundamentally broken. UK vacancies have dropped for 36 straight months, the average role now gets 280 applications, 75% of CVs are rejected by an algorithm before a human sees them, and 1 in 3 UK job ads may be ghost jobs with no real hiring intent.

This video breaks down the 4 reasons the UK job market collapsed, what hiring looks like in 2027, and the 3 specific things you must do right now to stay ahead. Most candidates are still playing the 2020 game in a 2026 market. That's why nothing is working.


What you'll learn in this video:
- The 4 reasons the UK job market broke (remote work, AI, auto-apply, and the trust crisis)
- Why 75% of CVs get filtered by an ATS before a human reads them
- The 2027 prediction: why your personal brand replaces your CV
- How to spot ghost jobs that have no real hiring intent
- The 3 things you must start doing right now to land interviews in 2026
